title: Scenic Byway 12
direction: Runs east from US-89 near Red Canyon through canyon country, then north over Boulder Mountain to Torrey.

stretches.title: Canyon country
stretches.line: Small towns strung along the road through red and white rock country.

stretches.title: The Hogback
stretches.line: The stretch that includes the narrow ridge with drop-offs on both sides.

stretches.title: Over Boulder Mountain
stretches.line: A climb into forest and back down toward Capitol Reef country.
